statements.notes:
Look and feel your best with NaturesPlus Vanilla Collagen Peptides. Boost the health of your hair, skin, nails, joints, immune system and much more with the power of collagen protein peptides in a delicious vanilla flavor you'll love!
NaturesPlus Vanilla Collagen Peptides provides the highest quality Collogen available:
Sourced from Grass-Fed beef, Wild-caught cod, Cage-free chicken and Eggshell membrane. Clean, sustainable ingredients are the best choice of collagen sources.
These 6 major Collagen Types (I,II,III,IV,V & X) provide a powerful profile delivering exceptional whole body benefits
Superior source hydrolyzed collagen with collagen digesting enzymes to maximize absorption.

Full spectrum collagen provide whole body results:
Type I - Skin elasticity
Type II - Joints and immune system
Type III - Skin, blood vessels, vital organs
Type IV - Cell health and growth
Type V - Skin, tendons and immune system
Type X - Joints, bones, muscles and hair
Clean Pure Optimized
Don't settle for non-hydrolyzed collagen!
These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease.

Vanilla with other natural flavors
Grass fed beef
Cage-free chicken
Eggshell membrane

Soft skin
Strong nails
Hair growth
Gut health
Joint relief
Clean ingredients, clean taste

Directions: Add 26g (2 heaping scoops) of Vanilla Collagen Peptide powder to 8 fl. oz. of water or juice, or to recipe of your choice.
NautesPlus's superior collagen forms mix quickly and easily. No blender required!

Free from synthetic colors, preservatives.
Does not contain crustacean shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soy or sesame.
Keep tightly closed in a cool, dry place.
Keep out of reach of children.
Not to be used as the sole source of dietary calories or protein.
